|rulings=* [[Yoda]]'s battle and attack prevention text affects both players.<ref name="scomp" />
* 'Where present am I' means [[Yoda]] must be present at the location (not inside a starship or enclosed vehicle). This also means it could only work at a site.
* Effective game text: Deploys only on Dagobah. When the mentor, adds 1 to training destiny. While present at a site (and no opponent's character of ability > 3 present here), battles and attacks may not be initiated here. Immune to attrition.

|notes=In a collecting-thread post of 3 December 2002, reposted by [[Scott Lingrell]] on the Players Committee forum on 13 December 2005, [[Jim Colson]] wrote that half of the Dagobah Yodas have a small hairlike black mark on the back of the card. He wrote that it was brought to their attention at the [[1998 Decipher World Championship|1998 World Championship]], where unmarked copies had to be available for anyone playing with a marked one, to avoid cheating issues, and that this little-known misprint had no known value difference.<ref name="pcf-5796-113113">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=113113#113113 Trade/Collecting Questions], Jim Colson (Shadowleader), post of 3 December 2002 reposted by Scott Lingrell (CRingwell), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (13 December 2005).
